Public Portion 
 1. Continued discussion on the Woodland Ordinance 
 
Minutes: 
On May 18, 2026, the Sustainability and Environment Subcommittee, chaired by Councilor 
Victor Davila, continued its review of a proposed Woodland Ordinance intended to protect 
privately owned woodland areas while balancing responsible development. The committee 
reviewed a revised summary document prepared by SCANS based on prior feedback from the 
Law Department. The proposal outlines the ordinance's purpose, applicability, permitting 
process, mitigation requirements, commission structure, and enforcement provisions.   
The committee discussed the proposed applicability thresholds, exemptions for routine tree 
removal, permit requirements, mitigation fees, tree replacement, and the creation of a 
commission to oversee applications. Members also reviewed how permit fees and fines would be 
distributed under the proposal and discussed the potential financial impact on larger development 
projects.  
To support further review, the committee requested a case study to estimate potential costs for 
developers under the proposed ordinance. The City Forester and SCANS agreed to work together 
on the analysis. Members also discussed obtaining input from developers and tree removal 
companies before finalizing the proposal. The chair requested that the Law Department begin 
preparing a draft ordinance while stakeholder outreach and additional analysis continue. The 
committee scheduled its next meeting for July 28, 2026, at 11:00 a.m.   
Meeting adjourned: 1:58 p.m
